snippet.title: "Dance DeLight" Mobile Java Game from "Nokia 3220"
snippet.description:
Клавиатура с разъемом ps2 в Санкт-Петербурге (есть Авито доставка)
https://www.avito.ru/sankt-peterburg/tovary_dlya_kompyutera/klaviatura_s_razemom_ps2_8081017051

"Dance DeLight" is Mobile Game from "Nokia 3320"! 
It is Java game, you can download and play it here:
http://barrarchiverio.7m.pl/p/DanceDelight.jar
http://s40game.mw.lt/www/d/DanceDeLight.jar
The game is built-in (embedded) from Nokia 3220 phones, released by Nokia in 2004.
